nome_jp: 終剣連結アビスハリケーン
testo:
EX Life
Powered Breaker
■ All creatures gets "speed attacker" and can't block.
■ Each creature attacks if able.
■ After a creature attacks, destroy that creature.
■ If this creature doesn't have an "EX Life" shield, this creature gets +12000 power.
